name: sts-geoflow-android
description: Native Android shell for the STS GeoFlow field logger

scripts.android:add: npm run build:web && npx cap add android
scripts.android:sync: npm run build:web && npx cap sync android
scripts.android:open: npm run android:sync && npx cap open android
scripts.android:debug: npm run android:sync && npm run android:assets && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleDebug
